notes: Whole common question words and particles-as-words (how, why, what, which, I/my, a bit, can, should, do-it forms, please tell me). Doubtful: 수 and 때 (single-syllable, but only dropped when they stand alone as a word, never as content), 더 (more, could in rare cases be wanted as in 더 빠르게; it is a whole word so only dropped alone). Content words like 코드, 연습, 박자, 줄, 손가락 are not listed.
